paper_metadata.title: Novel Ni–Co-based superalloys with high thermal stability and specific yield stress discovered by directed energy deposition

evidence.quote: Novel Ni – Co-based superalloys with high thermal stability and specific yield stress discovered by directed energy deposition
We report on the rapid alloy screening of Ni – Co – Ti – Al – Mo superalloys with high thermal stability and specific yield stress by means of directed energy deposition.
